subject: Observability onramp: POC plan & success criteria
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.example.com>
To: Alex Reynolds <alex@velvetpay.com>, Priya Shah <priya@velvetpay.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.example.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.example.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.example.com>
Date: 2026-11-01T16:12:00-07:00
Subject: Observability onramp: POC plan & success criteria

Thanks again for the call today — good to meet the VelvetPay team. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment before the trial kickoff:

Summary / goals
- Primary objective: validate that Redwood inference can deliver sub-150ms median latency for your payment-intent model at 500 TPS and keep per-token cost within your target.
- Secondary: ensure traceability for payment flow (end-to-end traces across client->api->model) and confirm secure log export for audit purposes.

Proposed success criteria (attached as starter spreadsheet):
- 95th percentile latency <= 400ms under steady-state load (500 TPS)
- KV cache hit rate >= 65% for repeated user sessions
- Token cost per request <= $0.007 average over 2-week trial
- No more than 1 incident requiring failover per week

Observability scope for POC (high level)
- Dashboards: latency percentiles, token cost breakdown, cache hit rate, model fallback rate, error traces by endpoint
- Tracing: distributed traces with sample traces for payments flows (root span -> model call -> downstream services)
- Logs: structured request/response logs exported to your S3 for audit retention
- Alerts: regression alerts tied to baseline prompt-set and SLA thresholds

Next steps / timeline
1) Confirm success criteria edits (reply inline) — by 2026-11-03
2) Provide read-only AWS role ARN + sample logs so Marissa can configure log export — by 2026-11-04
3) Kickoff technical onramp call: proposed 2026-11-05 10:00 AM PT
4) Trial start: target 2026-11-08, 2-week run

Attachments: POC-Success-Criteria.xlsx (starter)

If this looks good I’ll lock in the kickoff invite.

—Dylan
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Alex Reynolds <alex@velvetpay.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.example.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya@velvetpay.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.example.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.example.com>
Date: 2026-11-01T19:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Observability onramp: POC plan & success criteria

Thanks Dylan — appreciate the clear recap. A few small edits from our side: we agree with the majority of the criteria but would like to add:
- Log export must include full request_id and masked payment tokens (we will provide a masking spec)
- Retention requirement: logs must be exportable for 90 days; we won't need Redwood to store long-term but we need export to our S3 for compliance

Also: can you confirm whether you support trace correlation IDs that we can propagate into our downstream systems? That's critical for our debug workflows.

We can provide the AWS role ARN and sample logs today — I'll send those in a follow-up. Kickoff time looks good; 11/05 10am PT works for our infra lead.

—Alex
Alex Reynolds
Head of Infra, VelvetPay
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.example.com>
To: Alex Reynolds <alex@velvetpay.com>, Priya Shah <priya@velvetpay.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.example.com>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.example.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.example.com>
Date: 2026-11-02T09:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Observability onramp: POC plan & success criteria

Great — thanks Alex. Quick technical plan for the POC observability onramp so you know exactly what we'll deliver and what we need from you: 

Deliverables (POC observability) — 2 week trial- Dashboards (Marissa owner):
  - Latency: p50 / p95 / p99 by endpoint and model version
  - Cost: token-level cost breakdown, tokens per request distribution
  - Cache: KV cache hit/miss rate and per-client hit rate heatmap
  - Reliability: model fallback rate, error-types (timeout / rate-limit / model-error)
  - Business KPI: requests with payment_success true per minute (sampled)

- Tracing (sample config):
  - Distributed traces with a correlation_id propagated from client -> api -> model call
  - Sample rate: 1% global + 100% for requests that hit error thresholds (error sampling)
  - Example span names and attributes provided during kickoff

- Logs
  - Structured JSON logs exported to your S3 bucket (we'll write to s3://velvetpay-redwood-poc/incoming/)
  - Fields: timestamp, request_id, correlation_id, endpoint, model_version, token_count, masked_payment_token, status_code

- Alerts
  - Regression alert: p95 latency increases >20% vs baseline (alert to Slack + email)
  - Cost alert: token cost daily > expected budget threshold

What we need from VelvetPay
- Read-only AWS role ARN with S3 write permission (so we can deliver logs) and permissions to put CloudWatch for trace ingestion if you use that path.
- Example log file (1-2 MB) with real-ish masked records so we can validate parsers.
- List of top 5 endpoints you want us to prioritize for dashboard coverage.

Ownership
- Dashboards: Marissa Cole (marissa_cole)
- Success metric tracking & weekly-runbook: Rafael Mendes (rafael_mendes)
- Regression/quality alerts & evals: Soojin Lee (soojin_lee)
- Sales / stakeholder communications: Dylan Brooks (dylan_brooks)

Attachments: observability-dashboard-mockup.png (simple mockup)

I will draft the kickoff agenda and share a short runbook during the call. If you can drop the ARN and sample log by EOD tomorrow (11/04) we’ll be ready to start on 11/08.

—Marissa
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Priya Shah <priya@velvetpay.com>

Perfect — thanks for the quick turnaround, Priya and Alex. Confirming the plan and next steps: 

- Kickoff: 2026-11-05 10:00 AM PT (calendar invite sent)
- Trial window: 2026-11-08 -> 2026-11-22 (2 weeks)
- Deliverables by end of week 1: baseline dashboards + trace sampling configured
- Deliverables by end of trial: full dashboard set, export verification to your S3 path, weekly runbook with playbook for incidents

- Provide any additional endpoints to prioritize (Priya / Alex) — action: today
- Marissa to provision dashboards and share initial links during the kickoff (Marissa)
- Rafael to publish the weekly success tracking sheet (Rafael)
- Soojin to drop a regression-alert playbook for your SREs (Soojin)
